identification: Two oval gilt-framed wall mirrors (description: 2 GILT FRAMED WALL MIRRORS). Left (larger, taller oval): moulded gilt composition/gesso frame with leaf-and-scroll relief and beaded inner edge, bevel-free mirror plate. Right (smaller, rounder oval): gilt frame with black-highlighted leafy scroll pattern and fine beaded inner edge. Both look 20th century decorative reproduction frames.
